name: SS - Video Marquee
description: Experimental editorial video marquee section with a continuously scrolling horizontal strip of video tiles. Features infinite loop CSS animation, hover-to-pause interaction, editorial mega typography overlay, diagonal divider accents, rounded tile shapes, ambient glow, and scroll-triggered reveal. Each tile supports Shopify hosted video, YouTube/Vimeo, and MP4 URLs with poster fallback. Ideal for showreels, portfolio pages, and creative agencies. 60+ customization options.
author: Section Hub
